tuned.description: Frozen 2026-10-13, chosen on the DEV split only (no TEST question was ranked or scored): highest dev nDCG@10 of hybrid_rerank (tie-break recall@10), preferring fewer non-default options within 0.01 (docs/rag-tuning.md). Options: date_prior 3, statement_boost 1.5, year_prior 1.25, recency_prior 1 with a 90-day half-life. Everything else is phase3: BM25 without stemming or query expansion, RRF k=60 with equal weights, 50 candidates, and the MiniLM-L-6 cross-encoder, pinned here to the commit the settings use so the preset does not follow a RERANKER_MODEL change. The production default (RETRIEVER_PRESET) since the one TEST evaluation, where the switch rule decided before that run held (docs/rag-tuning.md).
